import hashlib,json,os,platform,subprocess,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/jasonqin/Documents/GitHub/fprisc');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tests'))
from check_scheduler_latency import source,stats,HAL
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rounds=1024;repetitions=13;forms={}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fpr-copy-outlier-') as directory:
 t=Path(directory);src=t/'copy.fpr';src.write_text(source('copy',rounds))
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('FPR_')}
 env.update(FPR_HOME=str(root),FPR_PATH=str(root),XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(t/'cache'),FPR_HARTS='4',FPR_BLOCK_SPIN_NS='0')
 builds={}
 for name,compiler in [('before',Path('/tmp/fpr-before-finite-field-workers-189')),('after',root/'fpr')]:
  exe=t/name
  p=subprocess.run([compiler,'build',src,'--harts','4','--with',HAL,'-o',exe],cwd=root,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
  assert p.returncode==0,(name,p.stdout[-2000:],p.stderr[-5000:])
  symbols=subprocess.check_output(['nm',exe],text=True)
  assert '\n_fpr_sched_probe' not in symbols and ' _fpr_sched_probe\n' not in symbols
  builds[name]=exe
  forms[name]=dict(compiler_sha256=sha(compiler),source_sha256=sha(src),runs=[])
 # Both builds finish before any latency measurements. Alternate the order.
 for repetition in range(repetitions):
  for name in list(builds)[::1 if repetition%2==0 else -1]:
   p=subprocess.run([builds[name],'remote','one'],cwd=root,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
   assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr,(name,p)
   answer,*times=map(int,p.stdout.splitlines())
   assert answer==rounds*(rounds+3)//2 and len(times)==rounds and min(times)>=0
   forms[name]['runs'].append(dict(repetition=repetition,samples_us=times,**stats(times,1000)))
 for name,result in forms.items():
  result['summary']=stats([v for r in result['runs'] for v in r['samples_us']],1000)
  print(name,result['summary'],flush=True)
record=dict(compiler_sha256=sha(root/'fpr'),harness_sha256=sha(root/'tests/check_scheduler_latency.py'),probe_sha256=sha(HAL),host=platform.platform(),shape='copy',harts=4,route='remote',competitors=1,rounds=rounds,repetitions=repetitions,results=forms,reason='Investigate four observations over 1 ms in the full matrix; preserve the original record.
